IND.detail: Head coach Rick Carlisle said Wednesday that Haliburton (hamstring) will miss at least 10 more days, Alex Golden of SI.com reports.

IND.detail: Furphy (knee) is practicing with the G League's Noblesville Boom, per Alex Golden of SI.com.

SAC.name: Precious Achiuwa
SAC.detail: Achiuwa left Tuesday's 107-100 loss to the Magic with a left lower leg contusion and did not return, Matt George of ABC 10 Sacramento reports.

SAC.name: Ben Simmons

SA.name: Jayden Quaintance

UTAH.name: Lauri Markkanen

UTAH.name: Jusuf Nurkic
UTAH.detail: Nurkic (toe) has begun participating in on-court activities as he continues recovering from a right foot injury sustained during an Oct. 4 preseason game against Denver. He will be re-evaluated in two weeks, the Jazz announced Friday.

UTAH.name: Jaren Jackson Jr.
UTAH.detail: Jackson has been diagnosed with a torn MCL in his right knee and will be sidelined for 6-to-8 weeks, per Shams Charania of ESPN.
